title: nf-core/bacmodel pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fasta.errorMessage: Assembly FASTA file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fasta', '.fa', '.fna', with or without a '.gz' suffix.

medium_gapseq.description: Built-in gapseq medium name (e.g. 'LB', 'M9'). Mutually exclusive with 'medium_gapseq_csv'. If both are empty, gapseq auto-predicts the medium. See docs/usage.md#metabolic-modeling-media
medium_gapseq.errorMessage: Medium name for gapseq cannot contain spaces or slashes. Must be a built-in medium name (e.g., 'LB', 'M9'). To use a custom medium CSV file, use the 'medium_gapseq_csv' column instead. See docs/usage.md#metabolic-modeling-media

medium_gapseq_csv.description: Path to a custom gapseq medium file - comma-separated (.csv), columns: compounds, name, maxFlux. See assets/medium_gapseq_example.csv and docs/usage.md#metabolic-modeling-media
medium_gapseq_csv.errorMessage: Custom gapseq medium file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.csv'. See assets/medium_gapseq_example.csv for the expected format and docs/usage.md#metabolic-modeling-media

medium_carveme.description: Built-in CarveMe medium name (e.g. 'LB', 'M9'). If empty, no gap-filling is performed. See docs/usage.md#metabolic-modeling-media
medium_carveme.errorMessage: Medium name for CarveMe cannot contain spaces or slashes. Must correspond to a medium in the mediadb (e.g., 'LB', 'M9'). See docs/usage.md#metabolic-modeling-media

medium_carveme_tsv.description: Path to a custom CarveMe media database - tab-separated (.tsv), columns: medium, description, compound, name. Overrides --carveme_mediadb for this sample only. See assets/medium_carveme_mediadb_example.tsv and docs/usage.md#metabolic-modeling-media
medium_carveme_tsv.errorMessage: Custom CarveMe media database cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.tsv' (tab-separated). Overrides --carveme_mediadb for this sample only. See assets/medium_carveme_mediadb_example.tsv for the expected format and docs/usage.md#metabolic-modeling-media
